summary: A committee chair interrupts a proposal long enough to arrange a cost estimate.
realLife: Riddick recalled Carl Hayden calling the Bureau of the Budget during their first discussion of the Daily Digest to arrange for Riddick to estimate its cost.
inGame: needs: a proposed service and a cost-estimate request.

turns.what: The sponsor returns with projected shifts.
turns.pulledBy: The budget staff need a staffing plan.
turns.writesBack: The estimate uses the revised plan.

turns.what: The analyst asks for its costs.
turns.pulledBy: A comparable service already has accounts.
